rationale.consistency: Perfectly mirrors the conventions of existing Caddy logging modules and reuses existing types where appropriate.
rationale.edge_cases: Accurately parses malformed Set-Cookie strings, handles values with or without attributes, and elegantly preserves original quoting.
rationale.scope: Implements exactly the requested functionality with no unnecessary refactoring or extraneous additions.
rationale.readability: The logic is straightforward and readable, with helpful comments explaining the dummy Response parser and attribute preservation.
rationale.robustness: Safe string cutting and array bound checks guarantee no panics, even on highly malformed header values.
rationale.maintainability: Self-contained and clean implementation that seamlessly fits into the existing filter architecture.
